fields.description: Array of field definitions for the collection schema.

default_sorting_field.description: Name of the field to sort by when no sort_by parameter is specified.

token_separators.description: Characters to use as token separators in addition to whitespace.

symbols_to_index.description: Characters that should be indexed as part of tokens.

enable_nested_fields.description: Whether to enable indexing of nested object fields.

synonym_sets.description: List of synonym set names to attach to this collection.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to store with the collection.
